description.value:
You target a manufactured metal object you can see within range — a blaster, or a suit of medium or heavy metal armor, for example — causing it to glow white-hot. Any creature touching the object when you cast the power takes 2d8 fire damage, and for the duration you can use a bonus action on later turns to inflict this damage again.

If a creature wearing, wielding, or otherwise in contact with the object takes this damage, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or drop the object (if able); if it can't or doesn't drop it, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 per slot level beyond 2nd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
